deployments_detail.use: "SCAN ME" AI image product search (own Kaiba Lab); "Campus Donki" unmanned store (AI + weight sensors, Jul 2025); AI dynamic pricing

'AI創業会長' (AI Founder Chairman): a conversational AI avatar of founder Takao Yasuda, co-developed with AIdeaLab, reproducing his speaking style, voice and philosophy from his books, materials, and internal video/audio (RAG-based dialogue model). Installed at a newly built space in PPIH's Shibuya headquarters for internal use. [AIdeaLab]

AI pricing system 'Kakaku Mill' (価格ミル): AI recommends store prices based on competitor pricing, weather, temperature and past sales; recommendations shown on staff smartphone terminals. Rolled out to all Don Quijote stores during the fiscal year ended June 2023. Staff retain discretion (AI-recommended prices adopted ~50% of the time on average). [PPIH in-house]
deployments_detail.value: Deployed to all Don Quijote stores by FY ending June 2023; ~50% adoption rate of AI recommendations

deployments_detail.use: 'Campus Donki' unmanned checkout-free small store: AI cameras recognize customer movement, posture and products, combined with per-shelf weight sensors, to enable automatic checkout (LINE QR entry, cashless auto-payment). Uses NTT Data's Catch&Go digital store service; opened at Osaka Electro-Communication University in 2025. [NTT Data (Catch&Go)]

Graph Neural Network (GNN)-based personalized product recommendation and coupon targeting on the majica app: learns from a customer's purchase history plus data from similar customers to predict next likely purchases and optimize per-customer discount rates (~50 variables). Completed three PoC rounds; full operational launch targeted for August 2026. [PPIH (GNN)]
deployments_detail.value: PoC1 (10,000 customers) achieved 59x higher coupon utilization vs standard promotions; ~5x improvement overall; full launch targeted Aug 2026

deployments_detail.use: Retail-media audience targeting 'co-buy Audience Plus': Data One (PPIH-affiliated retail media venture) uses NTT Docomo's AI engine plus real ID-POS purchase data (including PPIH majica member data) to estimate lookalike customers and deliver targeted advertising across online/offline channels. [Data One; NTT Docomo (AI engine)]

majica app customer-experience personalization with Plaid's KARTE for App and KARTE Datahub: real-time analysis and visualization of individual in-app customer behavior, unifying purchase/POS/behavioral data to drive one-to-one personalized content and communication for majica's ~15M members. [Plaid (KARTE for App, KARTE Datahub)]

In-store product AI image search service ('AI商品ナビ' / 'SCAN ME'): customers upload a smartphone photo of a desired product and the system locates it on shelves within the store; also helps staff re-shelve misplaced items. Built with BrainPad and PPIH's Kaibara Lab using Google Cloud Gemini and Vertex AI image recognition to construct a shelf-allocation database. [BrainPad; Kaibara Lab; Google Cloud (Gemini, Vertex AI / Vision AI, Vector Search)]
deployments_detail.value: Don Quijote Shibuya flagship (~1.3M products; ~70% of sales from inbound tourists); 100% top-5 recognition accuracy for single-product images; PPIH plans 40 stores nationwide by FY2026

deployments_detail.use: AI security/anti-theft cameras: PPIH installs cameras with facial-identification functionality at store entrances and AI that detects shoplifting-type behaviors from camera images to aid crime prevention, per PPIH's official store security-camera privacy notice. [not named]
